nodes.question: What methodology was used to create the initial list of world leading UPF corporations?
nodes.answer: The methodology included collating data on UPF categories, searching for business association and MI membership disclosures on corporate websites, and conducting searches on Google and Google Scholar for relevant academic and grey literature.
